answer: Each identity is admitted only after a Wesolowski VDF completes a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with a succinct proof checked afterward. A mirror set of Sybil clones cannot shorten any individual chain by distributing its dependent steps across GPUs; each clone still incurs a real elapsed-time and compute cost, though separate machines may run clones concurrently. The vault accepts identities only on valid completion, making mass creation a costly race against the dawn of the next protocol epoch.
